test_title: PYST 16 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 18 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: P walks 20 km towards north. He turns right and walks 40 km. He again turns right and walks 20 km. How far (in km) and in which direction is he now from the starting point?
solution:
Given:

P walks 20 km towards north.

He turns right and walks 40 km.

He again turns right and walks 20 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c89600df9a6a8c8ffb300edd3a50e318a962b7da17811d1394d4196f5f0a589b.png] 

So, net vertical displacement = 20 − 20 = 0 km (north-south)

Net horizontal displacement = 40 km (east-west) = 40 km East

Hence, P is 40 km **East** from the starting point.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
